# Agoda
> Agoda is an online travel platform for booking hotels, homes, flights, and activities worldwide.

Agoda serves travelers with search, booking, loyalty, and customer support experiences, while also providing partner-facing tools for accommodation providers, connectivity partners, and affiliates.

## Traveler Help Center
- [Help Center](https://www.agoda.com/info/contact.html): Central support hub for booking, payment, cancellation, and account questions.
- [Contact Us](https://www.agoda.com/info/contact.html): Customer service entry point for self-service and support options.
- [Booking Conditions](https://www.agoda.com/info/booking_conditions.html): Terms and conditions governing reservations made through Agoda.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.agoda.com/info/privacy.html): Explains how Agoda collects, uses, and protects personal data.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.agoda.com/info/cookie_policy.html): Details Agoda’s use of cookies and similar tracking technologies.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.agoda.com/info/termsofuse.html): Legal terms for using Agoda websites, apps, and services.

## Travel Products
- [Hotels](https://www.agoda.com/): Main hotel and accommodation search and booking experience.
- [Homes & Apartments](https://www.agoda.com/homes): Vacation rental and apartment booking marketplace for travelers.
- [Flights](https://www.agoda.com/flights): Flight search and booking product integrated into Agoda travel planning.
- [Airport Transfers](https://www.agoda.com/airporttransfer): Ground transportation booking for airport pickup and drop-off.
- [Activities](https://www.agoda.com/activities): Tours, attractions, and local activity booking marketplace.
- [Coupons & Deals](https://www.agoda.com/deals): Promotional offers, discounts, and travel deal listings.

## Partner Solutions
- [Agoda Partner Hub](https://partnerhub.agoda.com/): Main partner portal for accommodation providers and business partners.
- [YCS for Hotels](https://ycs.agoda.com/): Extranet for property partners to manage rates, inventory, and reservations.
- [Supply Connectivity](https://partnerhub.agoda.com/supply-connectivity): Information for channel managers and connectivity integration partners.
- [Affiliate Partners](https://partnerhub.agoda.com/affiliate-partners): Partnership options for affiliates promoting Agoda inventory.
- [Accommodation Partners](https://partnerhub.agoda.com/accommodation-partners): Overview of tools and programs for lodging partners.
- [Partner Support](https://partnerhub.agoda.com/support): Support resources for Agoda accommodation and business partners.

## Partner Guides & Resources
- [Partner Hub Blog](https://partnerhub.agoda.com/blog): Articles and updates for Agoda property and business partners.
- [Resource Center](https://partnerhub.agoda.com/resource-center): Educational materials, operational guidance, and partner best practices.
- [Getting Started](https://partnerhub.agoda.com/getting-started): Onboarding information for new accommodation partners.
- [Demand & Marketing](https://partnerhub.agoda.com/demand-marketing): Guidance on visibility, promotions, and demand generation tools.
- [Property Management](https://partnerhub.agoda.com/property-management): Operational advice for managing listings and reservations effectively.
- [Payments for Partners](https://partnerhub.agoda.com/payments): Information about partner payment processes and related topics.

## Company Information
- [About Agoda](https://www.agoda.com/info/about_agoda.html): Company overview, background, and Agoda brand information.
- [Press Center](https://www.agoda.com/press): News, announcements, and media resources about Agoda.
- [Careers](https://careersatagoda.com/): Jobs, culture, and hiring information for Agoda teams worldwide.
- [Investor and Corporate Information](https://www.bookingholdings.com/): Parent company corporate information through Booking Holdings.
- [Sustainability](https://www.agoda.com/info/sustainability.html): Agoda initiatives and information related to sustainable travel.
- [Trust & Safety](https://www.agoda.com/info/security.html): Security-related information for Agoda users and platform visitors.

## Loyalty & Programs
- [VIP Program](https://www.agoda.com/vip): Loyalty-style benefits and exclusive discounts for eligible users.
- [PointsMAX](https://www.agoda.com/pointsmax): Earn airline miles and loyalty points on qualifying hotel bookings.
- [AgodaCash](https://www.agoda.com/agodacash): Wallet and credit-related information for Agoda users.
- [Referral Program](https://www.agoda.com/referral): Invite-based rewards and referral benefits for eligible customers.

- [Agoda United States](https://www.agoda.com/en-us/): English-language Agoda site for U.S. users.
- [Agoda United Kingdom](https://www.agoda.com/en-gb/): English-language Agoda site for U.K. users.
- [Agoda Singapore](https://www.agoda.com/en-sg/): Localized Agoda experience for Singapore users.
- [Agoda Japan](https://www.agoda.com/ja-jp/): Japanese-language localized Agoda booking experience.

- [Agoda Thailand](https://www.agoda.com/th-th/): Thai-language localized Agoda booking experience.
